# Horse Racing Companion

> An independent iPhone app for race-day attendees at Del Mar. For each race it
> turns public odds, Del Mar history, and live race-day updates into one clear
> single-race bet recommendation, or an honest pass, with one small ticket up
> to $5 and the exact words to say at the betting window. It never places or
> accepts wagers, and it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by
> Del Mar Thoroughbred Club.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). The first three racing days are free and include
  complete recommendations; after that a one-time, non-renewing $19.99 Del Mar
  season pass unlocks recommendations for the rest of the season. Race cards,
  results, and the how-it-works explanation stay free without a pass.
- The analysis uses public information only: morning-line odds and past Del
  Mar results (each horse's local record, trainer, jockey, their pairing, and
  post-position performance by surface and distance). No profit is guaranteed
  and recommendation confidence is not a win probability.
- Standout races are marked as strong plays; genuinely unclear races may
  show no bet. Confidence is shown as a visual meter, not a win probability.
- Responsible wagering: for adults of legal wagering age where wagering is
  lawful. Problem-gambling help: https://www.ncpgambling.org/
